node.statement: By def-hcb-datum, Q is a one-dimensional delta-projection, so dim S_Q=1. Therefore S_Q is not the zero space. The registered one-dimensional-projection-nonvanishing definition states that S_Q=0 exactly in the small alternative and that the opposite alternative is precisely nonvanishing. Thus Q is nonvanishing. This directly corrects the stale context assertion challenged at node 1.4.4.
